description: Jathea wears an ivory floor-length gown with a modest square neckline near the collarbones, wrist-length sleeves and fine woven texture beneath a plum layered outer dress and shoulder drape. Gold patterned borders edge the sleeves, front panels and hem. Two round shoulder clasps and a decorated belt with round fittings secure the cloth. A small pendant and earrings complement the outfit; both dark leather shoes are visible.
